msg.content: Where are the headquarters of the Big Five companies in the technology industry located?
Where are the headquarters of the Big Five companies in the technology industry located?

content.content: The user asks: "Where are the headquarters of the Big Five companies in the technology industry located?" Big Five likely refers to FAANG: Facebook (Meta), Amazon, Apple, Netflix, Google (Alphabet). Or sometimes Big Five includes Microsoft, Apple, Amazon, Google, Meta (FAAMG). The industry technology "Big Five" could be the top five tech giants: Apple, Microsoft, Amazon, Google (Alphabet), Meta (Facebook). Need to give locations: Apple - Cupertino, CA; Microsoft - Redmond, WA; Amazon - Seattle (or now HQ2 in Arlington, VA); Alphabet (Google) - Mountain View, CA; Meta - Menlo Park, CA. Provide answer.

content:
**Headquarters of the “Big Five” technology companies (often referred to as FAAMG or FAANG)**  

| Company | Parent/Brand | Headquarters (city, state, country) |
|---------|--------------|--------------------------------------|
| **Apple Inc.** | Apple | Cupertino, California, United States |
| **Microsoft Corp.** | Microsoft | Redmond, Washington, United States |
| **Amazon.com, Inc.** | Amazon | Seattle, Washington, United States (primary campus) – also notable second headquarters (HQ2) in Arlington, Virginia, United States |
| **Alphabet Inc.** (Google) | Google | Mountain View, California, United States |
| **Meta Platforms, Inc.** (formerly Facebook) | Meta | Menlo Park, California, United States |

These locations are the main corporate headquarters where each company’s senior executive team and central corporate functions are based. (Some of the firms also maintain additional large campuses or “second headquarters,” but the cities above are the official primary headquarters.)
